title: Place verdict
description: One stored row of .reliability/audit/places/<batch>.jsonl: the quick check's verdict on one place, or why it has none. The checker writes only placeId, verdict, confidence, summary, remaining, foundRule, evidence, mitigationsChecked, filesOpened and needs; the scanner's audit record command validates them and stamps the rest.

level.description: NONE for a no-hint sweep place.

symbol.description: Class.method enclosing the rule's first evidence; for a rule about a transaction, the method that opens it; for a no-hint place, the entry method.

verdict.description: Absent on UNJUDGED rows. MITIGATED only when a listed mitigation was FOUND in full and nothing remains.

draftVerdict.description: Stamped when the scanner recorded a stricter verdict than the draft: MITIGATED that names a remaining failure or has no mitigation FOUND in full becomes CONFIRMED; REFUTED that names one becomes UNCERTAIN.

remaining.description: Required in a REFUTED or MITIGATED draft: none, or how the failure still happens. Stored when it names something.

foundRule.description: For a CONFIRMED no-hint place: the rule code of the failure the sweep found.

confidence.description: Capped at MEDIUM when any mitigation was NOT_CHECKED.

evidence.description: Required for CONFIRMED, REFUTED and MITIGATED; each snippet must occur within two lines of its line.

mitigationsChecked.description: Every mitigation name of the rule's hypothesis, spelled as the packet gives it.

result.description: PARTIAL: the mitigation covers only some of the failures; it never makes a place MITIGATED.

needs.description: Required for UNCERTAIN: what would decide it.

filesOpened.description: Every file the checker opened besides the packet, printed ones included.

openedFiles.description: The files in filesOpened that the packet neither printed nor listed.

overBudget.description: Present when filesOpened exceeds the per-place budget of two.

tier.description: TRIAGE from the quick check. DEEP from a deep audit's scenarios: CONFIRMED when a scenario that breaks something explains the place, REFUTED when only harmless ones do. VERIFIED once every finding of the place was verified or disproved; REFUTED when all were disproved. The highest current tier wins.

flowId.description: DEEP and VERIFIED rows: the flow whose scenarios judged the place.

findingIds.description: DEEP and VERIFIED rows: the findings derived from those scenarios.

core.description: SHA-256 of the methods around the rule's evidence, the cited effects and the mitigation signals; the verdict is stale when it no longer matches the tree.

opened.description: SHA-256 of openedFiles' contents; the verdict is stale when it no longer matches.

status.description: As recorded. STALE is computed when the files are read, never stored.

reason.description: Why an UNJUDGED row has no verdict.

problems.description: For reason rejected: what failed validation.
